text: Training objectives: This major cultivates high-quality application-oriented professionals who meet the needs of economic and social development, have excellent general knowledge, solid professional quality, outstanding innovation quality, comprehensive development of morality, intelligence, physique, beauty and labor, systematically master the basic theory, basic knowledge and basic skills of nursing major, have basic clinical nursing work ability, preliminary teaching ability, management ability, scientific research ability and innovation ability, and can engage in nursing and preventive health care in various medical and health care institutions. Characteristic advantages: medical education collaborative education, continuous optimization of teaching resources, reform of teaching methods, and promotion of students' independent learning. With nursing education experts from Tongji Hospital affiliated to Tongji Medical College of Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Wuhan University People's Hospital and other practice hospitals inside and outside the province, we have jointly built a nursing professional resource database and implemented the trinity teaching mode of "theoretical teaching-simulation training-clinical practice", and more than 90% of students are employed in domestic third-class hospitals.
